name: Ibi (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and white, charged at the centre with two red towers flanking a lozenge of the Senyera, the figures of the municipal arms of Ibi.
history: The flag of Ibi was recognised by resolution of the Conselleria de Justicia of 28 January 2003; the lozenge with the yellow and red bars symbolises its status as a royal town, as does the motto IBI REGII PATRIMONII of the arms.

features.role: lozenge with the red bars of the Senyera
